sloka: सुमित्रा प्रेक्ष्यवै भीता कथम् मे विश्वसिष्यति ।कृपणम् बत वैदेही श्रोष्यति द्वयमप्रियम् ॥२-१२-७२॥
transliteration: sumitrā prekṣyavai bhītā katham me viśvasiṣyati ।kṛpaṇam bata vaidehī śroṣyati dvayamapriyam ॥2-12-72॥

translations.english: Alas Sita will listen in a pitiable state the two unpleasant events namely my death and Rama's exile to the foest.
